description: Run a free instant SEO check of any public website, no account needed: Trakis reads its first 25 pages, grades them out of 100, counts each problem once with the number of pages it is on, and says whether robots.txt keeps AI assistants' bots off the site. Takes about a minute; returns a check_id to pass to get_check_result. A site already checked in the last day gets that check back.

url.description: The site's address, e.g. "example.com" or "https://www.example.com/". Only public sites.

name: check_site
title: Check a site
